# oiken_'s Vein Miner
I made this because I couldn't find any vein miners that I liked for NeoForge (on modrinth).

## Features:
- (should) work with every mod in existence (assuming they use the appropriate tags).
- has a configurable maximum number of blocks you can mine in any given vein (default is 64 blocks).
- click V, or any other key on your keyboard (you can change it) to disable/enable vein mining.
- crouch + mine to mine entire veins when vein mining is enabled.

---
if this mod doesn't work with an ore from another mod, then just open an issue in the issues tab on the mod's Github page and I'll (hopefully) fix it.
enjoy!
